title: work_completion_certificate
description: Extraction schema for work completion certificates (WCC).

work_order_ref.description: Work order number this WCC closes

certificate_date.description: Date the WCC was issued (may differ from completion)

issuing_authority.description: PMC or client representative who issued the certificate

scope_summary.description: Brief description of work scope completed

dlp_start_date.description: Defect liability period start (often same as completion_date)

final_bill_due_date.description: Deadline for contractor to submit final bill after WCC

conditions.description: Any conditions or pending items noted on the WCC
